basics.name: Alex Rivera
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Backend-leaning full-stack engineer with 8 years of experience building reliable, observable services for developer tooling and fintech platforms. Enjoys mentoring, incident response, and turning ambiguous requirements into shipped software.

work.name: Northwind Systems
work.summary: Lead engineer on the payments platform team, owning reliability and developer experience for a service processing millions of transactions per day.
highlights: Redesigned the retry and idempotency layer, cutting duplicate-charge incidents by 92%
Introduced structured tracing across 12 services, reducing mean time to diagnose outages from hours to minutes
Mentored 4 junior engineers, two of whom were promoted within a year

work.name: Fernwood Labs
work.summary: Built and maintained internal developer tooling used by 150+ engineers, including a CLI for local environment provisioning.
highlights: Shipped a self-service CLI that cut new-engineer onboarding time from 2 days to 3 hours
Migrated the CI pipeline to containerized runners, reducing average build time by 40%

projects.name: retryable
projects.description: An open-source idempotency and retry library for Node.js HTTP clients.
highlights: Adopted by 6 companies within the first year

publications.name: Idempotency Keys at Scale: Lessons from Production Payments Systems
publications.summary: A case study on designing and operating an idempotency layer for a high-throughput payments API.
